records.summary_text: Sierra Leone is dangerous for trans visitors. The 1861 Offences Against the Person Act criminalises buggery with up to life imprisonment (men only) — enforcement is limited but discrimination and violence are regular; no LGR; a small community organises quietly.

records.name: Kosovo
records.summary_text: Kosovo is workable for trans visitors — the Balkans' strongest legal framework on paper. The constitution (Art 24) bans discrimination based on sexual orientation; the 2015 Law on Protection from Discrimination covers gender identity; legal gender recognition is possible (medicalised); and the government attempted same-sex unions in 2024 as part of Council of Europe accession. Counterweights: implementation is inconsistent, political hate speech is common (2022 CSGD report: year marked by intolerance), and Pristina Pride proceeds under protection.
